# Vendored MathJax runtime

AgentFEM's documentation serves MathJax from the same GitHub Pages artifact so
equations do not depend on a third-party CDN during first load or instant
navigation.

- Package: `mathjax`
- Version: `3.2.2`
- Source: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/mathjax/v/3.2.2>
- Included component: `es5/tex-chtml-full.js`
- Included assets: CommonHTML TeX web fonts
- License: Apache-2.0; see `3.2.2/LICENSE`

The full TeX component is intentional: AgentFEM's scientific manual uses
`boldsymbol` and should not initiate a second extension download while a page
is being rendered.
